player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I fixated on the pattern "r_n_" and repeatedly guessed words starting with 'c' (crone, crane) or 'd' (drone) without systematically testing other valid consonants for the first and third positions. I also ignored the fact that 'o' was red in the third position of "crone" and "crane" but kept guessing words with 'o' in the third position (drone). Next time, once I have confirmed letters (r, n) and eliminated letters (s, l, a, t, e, c, o, w, d, y), I will immediately construct a guess using a completely new set of consonants for the unknown slots (e.g., "brine", "grind", "prune") rather than reusing eliminated letters or sticking to a single starting letter. I will ensure the third letter is not 'o' and the first letter is not 'c' or 'd'.
